section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single study of 247 Black college-bound older adolescent females examining associations among body dissatisfaction, body appreciation, body image flexibility, and BMI. Self-reported height and weight were used to calculate BMI, and respondents completed a culturally sensitive figure rating scale and assessments of body appreciation and body image flexibility. No country, mean age, mean BMI, instrument names (e.g., BAS/BAS-2), or numeric correlations are reported in the abstract.
